scope: SDK-01 targeted public consumer and multi-selection migration

cases.requirement: A standalone C consumer can link the installed V1 SDK and exercise real ABI/version and two-instance lifetime.
cases.oracle: ABI version equals CANVAS_RUNTIME_ABI_VERSION; invalid handle and version reject; two valid runtimes remain isolated after the first is destroyed; destroyed handles reject.

cases.requirement: A standalone C++ consumer links the same installed C ABI with correct language linkage.
cases.oracle: The linked function reports the exact V1 ABI version.

cases.requirement: A stale selected-appearance request is rejected; a fresh explicit request can update opacity without overwriting a concurrent stroke-width change.
cases.oracle: A 3-to-4 semantic-generation change produces kStaleTarget and no queued opacity change; refreshed request ID applies opacity 0.6 while preserving stroke width 19 and original fill.

cases.requirement: Partial applicability is explicit; unsupported roots are not silently changed.
cases.oracle: For selected shapes 1,2,3 and images 4,5, fill eligible IDs are 1,2,3, excluded IDs are 4,5 with kNotApplicable; read changes no canonical state, Scene or History.

cases.requirement: Partial property submission reports admission and final exact targets while preserving excluded roots and one-step Undo.
cases.oracle: Explicit local permission; three eligible shapes change to red, two excluded images do not change, pending has no changed IDs, final reports 3 changed/2 skipped; one Undo reverts all three.

cases.requirement: Semantic, selection and attachment changes do not allow stale target mutation.
cases.oracle: Stale submission or terminal receipt rejects with no unintended canonical, Scene or History change.

cases.requirement: Unknown/unreadable permission cannot authorize a write; explicit local single-user mode can enable supported edits.
cases.oracle: A change to unavailable context during drag causes no new semantic or Scene mutation and preserves redo; a real per-object deny source is still missing.

cases.requirement: Both real Debug UI consumers migrate to the public owner before the internal port is hidden.
cases.oracle: On Windows and actual Chrome/WASM, equivalent explicit permission, eligible/excluded projection, exact target and final receipt are observed; no internal accessor remains in either host.
